# Purchasing Reports

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Operator steps and checks” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “Screen references” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “List” instructions below.

> Ownership: Purchasing records commercial supplier commitments; Inventory posts physical quantities; Accounting and Payments manage AP and settlement.

## Operator steps and checks

Use the Purchasing Reports view to inspect purchasing commitments, supplier confirmations, overdue deliveries, quantities and spend under the available filters. Check whether a metric is based on ordered/confirmed/received quantities; these are different stages. Compare expected dates against received progress and open the source PO or inbound for exceptions. Reports are read-only evidence and are not a method for adjusting warehouse balances, posting AP or settling supplier payments. When comparing monetary totals, verify currency and reporting scope first.
